info.title: Our64
info.author: Ch0nbo
info.details:
Built on Not64 (the CPU recompiler) and GLideN64 (the graphics, with a new Wii U backend).

Main Features:
- Up to 4 players (GamePad, Pro Controller, Classic Controller, Wii Remote + Nunchuk)
- Save states + auto-resume
- Controller Pak, Rumble Pak, and Transfer Pak support (can read Game Boy saves from RetroArch & VC injects)

No games are included. Put your own .z64, .n64 or .v64 files in sd:/wiiu/our64/roms.

AI use: Co-written with AI.
